## Loading and preprocessing the data
```{r}
activity <- read.csv("activity.csv")
```

## What is mean total number of steps taken per day?
```{r}
total_steps <- tapply(activity$steps, activity$date, sum, na.rm=TRUE)
hist(total_steps, main="Total Steps per Day", xlab="Steps", col="blue")
mean_steps <- mean(total_steps, na.rm=TRUE)
median_steps <- median(total_steps, na.rm=TRUE)
print(paste("Mean:", mean_steps))
print(paste("Median:", median_steps))
```

## What is the average daily activity pattern?
```{r}
avg_steps <- tapply(activity$steps, activity$interval, mean, na.rm=TRUE)
plot(names(avg_steps), avg_steps, type="l", xlab="5-minute Interval", ylab="Average Steps", main="Average Daily Activity Pattern")
max_interval <- names(avg_steps)[which.max(avg_steps)]
print(paste("Max interval:", max_interval))
```

## Imputing missing values
```{r}
missing_vals <- sum(is.na(activity$steps))
print(paste("Missing values:", missing_vals))
activity_imputed <- activity
for (i in 1:nrow(activity_imputed)) {
  if (is.na(activity_imputed$steps[i])) {
    interval_val <- as.character(activity_imputed$interval[i])
    activity_imputed$steps[i] <- avg_steps[[interval_val]]
  }
}
total_steps_imputed <- tapply(activity_imputed$steps, activity_imputed$date, sum)
hist(total_steps_imputed, main="Total Steps per Day (Imputed)", xlab="Steps", col="green")
print(paste("Mean (Imputed):", mean(total_steps_imputed)))
print(paste("Median (Imputed):", median(total_steps_imputed)))
```

## Are there differences in activity patterns between weekdays and weekends?
```{r}
activity_imputed$date <- as.Date(activity_imputed$date)
activity_imputed$day_type <- ifelse(weekdays(activity_imputed$date) %in% c("Saturday", "Sunday"), "weekend", "weekday")
activity_imputed$day_type <- as.factor(activity_imputed$day_type)
par(mfrow=c(2,1))
weekday_data <- subset(activity_imputed, day_type == "weekday")
weekend_data <- subset(activity_imputed, day_type == "weekend")
plot(tapply(weekday_data$steps, weekday_data$interval, mean), type="l", main="Weekdays", xlab="Interval", ylab="Steps")
plot(tapply(weekend_data$steps, weekend_data$interval, mean), type="l", main="Weekends", xlab="Interval", ylab="Steps")
```
